title: Senior Mobile Engineer
description:
TITLE:

Senior Mobile Engineer


LOCATION/GEOGRAPHY:

Brasília, Brazil


REPortS TO:

R&D Manager


Role summary:

As a Senior Mobile Engineer at Vingcard, you will be instrumental in maintaining and developing new features for our native iOS and Android applications. With your extensive experience in mobile development, particularly in Swift and Kotlin, you will ensure the continuous enhancement of our mobile platforms. This role will involve leading the implementation of automated testing and CI/CD pipelines to improve app quality and reliability. You will also contribute to the integration of IoT devices and may explore hybrid mobile development using Flutter or React Native.


Key Responsibilities :

  • Develop and maintain native iOS and Android applications.
  • Implement new features and functionalities on the Athos mobile apps.
  • Design and execute automated tests to ensure the reliability and performance of mobile applications.
  • Establish and optimize CI/CD pipelines for mobile apps to streamline development and deployment processes.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including UX/UI designers, product managers, and backend engineers, to deliver high-quality mobile solutions.
  • Lead initiatives to integrate IoT devices with mobile applications, enhancing product capabilities.
  • Explore and possibly implement hybrid mobile development using Flutter or React Native as needed.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues in mobile apps, ensuring minimal downtime and high user satisfaction.


Key Relationships:

  • Work closely with Product Managers to understand requirements and deliver solutions that meet business objectives.
  • Collaborate with Designers to create intuitive, user-friendly mobile interfaces.
  • Engage with other Engineers to solve technical challenges and share best practices.
  • Interface with Quality Assurance teams to ensure thorough testing and validation of mobile applications.


Responsibilities and Authorities:

List of responsibilities and authorities:

  • Authority to make technical decisions regarding the design and architecture of mobile applications.
  • Access to development tools, version control systems, and other resources necessary for mobile app development.
  • Responsibility for the timely and high-quality delivery of mobile features and improvements.
  • Authority to mentor junior developers and guide them in best practices for mobile development.
  • Reporting to the R&D Manager for project updates, technical decisions, and career development matters.


Internal and External Contacts/Customers:

  • Regular collaboration with internal teams, including Product Management, Design, and Software Engineering.
  • Occasional engagement with external stakeholders, such as technology partners.


Key Competencies, Relevant Knowledge, Skills and Competencies:

  • Expertise in native iOS and Android development, with deep knowledge of Swift (for iOS) and Kotlin (for Android).
  • Experience in integrating IoT devices with mobile applications.
  • Proficiency in automated testing frameworks and CI/CD pipelines for mobile development.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex mobile app issues.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Adaptability and a continuous improvement mindset, with an eagerness to learn new technologies like Flutter or React Native.


Requirements:

  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in mobile app development, with a focus on native iOS and Android platforms.
  • Extensive experience with Kotlin and Swift, with a preference for Android development expertise.
  • Experience with IoT devices and hybrid mobile frameworks (Flutter/React Native) is a plus.


Education:

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, computer engineering or a related field.


Languages:

Proficiency in English and Brazilian Portuguese, both written and verbal.


Computer Skills:

  • Proficiency in development tools, version control systems (e.g., Git), and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Expertise in Swift and Kotlin, with familiarity in hybrid frameworks like Flutter or React Native.


Other Experience:

  • Senior Mobile Engineer or equivalent position in a software development environment.
  • Experience in mentoring and guiding junior developers.
  • Minimum 7 years experience.


Personal Qualities:

  • Strong leadership and mentoring abilities.
  • Proactive and self-motivated, with a drive to take initiative and lead mobile projects.
  • Detail-oriented with a focus on quality and best practices in mobile development.
  • Flexible and adaptable, with a passion for learning and implementing new technologies.


Expected outcome and deliverables:

Over the next 3-5 years, the Senior Mobile Engineer will significantly enhance the Athos mobile applications by implementing robust features, automated testing, and efficient CI/CD pipelines. The role will contribute to the integration of IoT devices, potentially explore hybrid mobile development, and drive the overall quality and performance of the apps. These efforts will solidify Athos's position as a leader in innovative mobile solutions, with noticeable improvements in app reliability, user satisfaction, and market competitiveness.


Vingcard Athos Team

The Vingcard Athos team, based in Brasília, Brazil, specializes in developing innovative solutions for the Build-to-Rent market, catering to both long and short-term rentals of furnished apartments. As a small and dynamic team, we manage the entire solution, including IoT devices, backend, frontend, and mobile applications.


We operate on a hybrid work model, with three days in the office and two days working from home. While our primary language of communication is Portuguese, all our code and documentation are in English, and meetings involving other teams are conducted in English.

Our team is an integral part of the Vingcard Research & Development organization headquartered in Sweden. We are thrilled to have you join us!


Contract Details

  • You will be a registered employee (CLT) of ASSA ABLOY GLOBAL SOLUTIONS IMPORTACAO EXPORTACAO DE EQUIPAMENTOS ELETRONICOS LTDA.
  • Benefits include Vale Refeição.
  • Benefits include health insurance (plano de saúde) for you, your spouse and your children at no additional cost.


We are the ASSA ABLOY Group

Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 61,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.


As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.


As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

title: Senior Frontend Developer
description:

Key Responsibilities

Need to Haves

  • 5+ years of production experience with React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript
  • Proven track record of delivering scalable, high-performance frontend solutions
  • Strong English skills – comfortable presenting technical decisions to stakeholders and writing detailed RFCs

Nice to Haves

  • Experience building and governing enterprise-grade design systems or HEX component libraries
  • Proficiency with Next.js, GraphQL, and cloud-native deployment (AWS Amplify, Vercel, or similar)

title: Oficial de Quarto de Náutica
description:
Procurando um desafio?


Seja em terra ou no mar, você encontra esse desafio na Edison Chouest Offshore . Somos uma família de empresas voltadas para resultados e apaixonadas pela excelência. Estamos orgulhosos do mosaico de pessoas que nos torna o fornecedor líder mundial de serviços marítimos.


A Bram Offshore Transportes Marítimos é uma empresa do Grupo Edison Chouest Offshore e especializada no transporte marítimo de apoio à indústria de petróleo e gás no Brasil. Desde a chegada da primeira embarcação do Grupo Chouest, em 1991, a frota em operação no Brasil vem aumentando, já contando com mais de 70 embarcações altamente especializadas, de última geração.


Quer se juntar a nós e fazer parte do time Offshore ?

title: Cientista de Desenvolvimento de Produtos III
description:
Descrição das Atividades:


  • Liderar o desenvolvimento e a comercialização de projetos de média a alta complexidade para desenvolver e comercializar inovações para produtos e processos novos e renovados, além de iniciativas de redução de custos;
  • Executar atividades de desenvolvimento de produtos e processos de média a alta complexidade, desde a concepção até a comercialização;
  • Identificar com precisão os requisitos do projeto, aplicando a capacidade de produção, os ingredientes, a formulação e o design adequados para atender às necessidades dos clientes, às especificações do produto e às metas financeiras;
  • Realizar avaliações sensoriais internas, aplicações de produtos e testes de validade para determinar a aceitabilidade de protótipos e produtos competitivos para clientes e consumidores;
  • Seguir as diretrizes e protocolos estabelecidos, abordagem científica e análise estatística no desenvolvimento de produtos, testes em fábricas, inicialização de fábricas, estudos sensoriais, estudos de estabilidade de validade, estudos de capacidade e desenvolvimento de especificações;
  • Fornecer suporte técnico para resolver problemas de média á alta complexidade relacionadas à produção e qualidade, identificando a causa raiz, desenvolvendo e implementando soluções, incluindo treinamento de pessoal de controle de qualidade/operações sobre as conclusões dentro da categoria de produto atribuída;
  • Apoiar um ambiente que promova a inovação, introduzindo continuamente ideias e conceitos de produtos para novos produtos, melhorias de qualidade e produtividade e facilitar a tomada de riscos calculados;
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento e a implementação da estratégia de matérias-primas em colaboração com o grupo da cadeia de abastecimento e fornecedores externos para obter um desempenho diferenciado dos novos produtos e qualidade ou redução de custos;
  • Desenvolver uma estratégia de matérias-primas em colaboração com o grupo da cadeia de abastecimento e fornecedores externos para obter um desempenho diferenciado dos novos produtos e qualidade;
  • Fornecer avaliações/perspectivas de risco técnico e comercial relacionadas com o desenvolvimento de novos produtos e atividades técnicas de gestão da marca;
  • Liderar, treinar e orientar técnicos;
  • Fornecer aconselhamento técnico a outros dentro da especialidade;


Experiências Anteriores:


  • Experiência comprovada na aplicação de normas técnicas, princípios, teorias, conceitos e interpretação de dados através de projetos experimentais sólidos e análises estatísticas (experiência em desenvolvimento de produtos e/ou processos alimentares, desde a concepção até a comercialização);
  • Sólido conhecimento em informática (Excel, Word, bancos de dados, software estatístico) e capacidade de criar planilhas, análises computacionais e relatórios;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de software relevantes (por exemplo, PLM, etc.). Capacidade de usar bancos de dados, software de apresentação e gerenciamento de projetos será um diferencial;


Formação Acadêmica:


  • Mestrado e/ou Doutorado em Ciência Alimentar, Química/Alimentar/Biológica ou áreas relacionadas;


Perfil Comportamental:


  • Foco em alcançar os objetivos do projeto e entregar resultados significativos;
  • Manter a responsabilidade pelos prazos e padrões de qualidade;
  • Adaptabilidade e resiliência: Confortável em lidar com ambiguidades, mudanças, prioridades e incertezas;
  • Lidar com riscos e desafios inesperados com serenidade e mentalidade voltada para a resolução de problemas;
  • Pensamento inovador: introduz continuamente novas ideias e conceitos para melhorias e inovação de produtos;
  • Colaboração e trabalho em equipe: trabalha de forma eficaz em ambientes multifuncionais;
  • Estabelecer relações sólidas com equipes internas e parceiros externos (fornecedores, instituições);
  • Comunicação e influência: comunica-se de forma clara e persuasiva em diferentes níveis da organização. Influencia decisões e alinha as partes interessadas em direção a objetivos comuns;
  • Liderança e orientação: Lidera e treina técnicos, fornecendo orientação e suporte técnico. Atua como um modelo de excelência técnica e comportamento profissional;
  • Atenção aos detalhes e pensamento analítico: Aplica projetos experimentais e análises estatísticas sólidas. Mantém a precisão na documentação, interpretação de dados e conformidade;
  • Orientação para o cliente e os negócios: Compreende as necessidades dos clientes e as traduz em soluções técnicas. Equilibra decisões técnicas com considerações financeiras e comerciais;

title: Senior Account Executive
description:
Syndigo powers the continual flow of data and content throughout the entire commerce ecosystem— accelerating delivery of accurate and compelling information that increases sales on every shelf. We are the recognized leader in software and services for the management of master data, product information, digital assets, and content syndication and analytics across industries including grocery, foodservice, hardlines, home improvement, oil & gas, pet, health and beauty, automotive, apparel, and healthcare products.

Syndigo serves the industry’s largest two-sided network, connecting more than 50,000 global users across 12,000+ global brands with more than 1,750 global retailers.

Basically, we're the people that deliver the rich, accurate product content that helps consumers shop online with confidence, and helps brands and retailers operate efficient product supply chains. We cannot do all of this without our amazing employees who make the magic happen here at Syndigo. As we continue to grow, we’re always looking to identify talented individuals to join our team.

**Candidate must be located in Joinville, Santa Catarina**

We are looking for a talented, communicative, and highly driven Senior Account Executive  to join our team at  Syndigo . In this role,  you’ll serve as a trusted partner to our clients—managing relationships, driving consultative sales, resolving issues, and supporting questions throughout the customer lifecycle. We value professionals who are agile, proactive, and passionate about delivering exceptional solutions.

HOW WE’LL BE WINNING TOGETHER DAY TO DAY

  • Manage the full consultative sales cycle, from prospecting to closing.  
  • Actively  identify  and engage potential customers to build a strong pipeline.  
  • Lead regular meetings with suppliers and clients to introduce  new solutions  and strengthen relationships.  
  • Conduct  timely  and  accurate  follow‑ups based on sales funnel stages.
  • Prepare, present, and deliver high‑quality commercial proposals.  
  • Negotiate pricing and commercial terms to successfully close opportunities.  
  • Maintain an organized schedule and ensure all lead/client information is accurately updated in the CRM.  
  • Lead retention discussions and negotiate solutions with suppliers at risk of  churn .  
  • Participate in onsite client visits as needed.  
  • Represent  Syndigo  at trade shows, fairs, and other industry events.  
  • Identify  opportunities to improve internal processes, product offerings, or customer experience.

WE SHOULD TALK IF THIS SOUNDS LIKE YOU 

  • 4+ years of relevant experience  
  • Bachelor’s degree  
  • Advanced English and Brazilian Portuguese  proficiency  
  • Proven experience in commercial sales roles  
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills  
  • Strong technical  proficiency   (Microsoft 365)  
  • Effective problem-solving, planning, and  organization  abilities
Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

To achieve the best version of our organization, we know it takes new ideas, new approaches, new perspectives and new ways of thinking. A purpose we are 100% committed to cultivating.

Diversity is woven into our fabric at Syndigo and it’s how we stay an industry leader, innovating technology solutions that equip our customers with everything they need to be successful! 

All are welcome here and we invite you to join our team if you are ready to help us continue that growth! 

GDPR/CCPA

Syndigo, to process applications, holds onto data for a "reasonable time" after applications are submitted. This data is stored for Syndigo's internal use by HR/Recruiting Staff only. Verified requests for data deletion and exports will be completed upon request.

Syndigo Job Applicant Privacy Notice

At Syndigo, we care about your privacy. As you go through our recruitment process, we are committed to being transparent about how we process your personal data. To learn more about how Syndigo processes your personal data, go to our Job Applicant Privacy Notice .

title: Engenheiro de Dados Pleno
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados para integrar nosso time responsável pela evolução de uma plataforma Data Lakehouse na AWS . Essa pessoa terá papel fundamental na integração de dados de múltiplas fontes, na orquestração de pipelines confiáveis e na disponibilização de camadas analíticas performáticas para consumo via Amazon Redshift e Power BI .


Modelo de atuação: Híbrido (2 a 3 vezes por semana)

Localidade: Brasília


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Projetar e implementar pipelines de dados utilizando Airflow/MWAA , com Python e SQL , seguindo boas práticas de modularidade, testes e versionamento.
  • Modelar camadas Bronze/Silver/Gold (arquitetura Medallion) em S3 + Glue Data Catalog , definindo partições, formatos (Parquet/Delta*) e tabelas otimizadas para consulta.
  • Construir e otimizar modelos analíticos em Amazon Redshift , garantindo performance e custo.
  • Publicar e manter datasets confiáveis para Power BI , incluindo gateways, incremental refresh, agregações e uso eficiente de DirectQuery/Import.
  • Colaborar com analistas e times de negócio, traduzindo necessidades em datasets, KPIs e camadas consumíveis, além de documentar catálogos e contratos de dados.


Requisitos e qualificações


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência sólida em AWS : S3, Glue Data Catalog, Airflow (preferencialmente MWAA), DAGs em Python, Amazon Redshift.

title: Finance Manager (Brazil)
description:
The Finance Manager will oversee all financial, accounting, and tax functions for the Brazilian entity, ensuring compliance with local statutory requirements, tax regulations, and corporate reporting standards. The role encompasses daily accounting operations, month-end and year-end closings, and statutory audits, while providing management with financial analysis, budgeting support, and strategic guidance. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical accounting expertise, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to excel in a fast-paced start-up environment.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for the maintenance of accurate financial reports and accounting records in line with corporate guidelines, corporate timelines and local statutory requirements.
  • Manage the full spectrum of the accounting functions, including accounts payables, accounts receivables, balance sheet schedules, general ledger maintenance, and cash flow management.
  • Manage closing processes and preparation of accurate and timely financial reports and analysis of financial information.
  • Ensure compliance with all federal, state, and municipal tax obligations.
  • Manage tax incentives including PPB (Processo Produtivo Básico) and tax optimization opportunities ensuring compliance with Brazilian tax laws.
  • Coordinate and liaise with external parties (e.g. banks, external auditors, tax agents, corporate secretarial agents, local tax and government authorities) to ensure smooth operations.
  • Collaborate across departments in preparing and managing the OPEX budgets.
  • Identify and implement process improvements in internal accounting and financial operations efficiency.
  • Partner with business units to provide finance-related advice.
  • Coordinate with headquarters to align local reporting with group consolidation requirements.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting.
  • Minimum 7 years of experience in finance and tax management, including 3+ years in an international setting.
  • Knowledge of Direct and Indirect tax.
  • Advanced analytical skills and high attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact with all levels of the organization.
  • Ability to work independently, manage pressure, and meet tight deadlines.
  • Proficiency in English.
  • Prior experience in accounting firms is an added advantage.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Mission Description:

Join our Advanced Analytics team as a Data Scientist in the Commercial Performance Tower. You will play a key role in designing, developing, and deploying scalable machine learning models that drive business impact. This is a hands-on role focused on model development, deployment, and optimization in real-world commercial environments.


About the Role:

We are seeking a skilled and proactive Data Scientist to strengthen our analytics capabilities. You will work on high-impact projects involving recommendation systems, demand forecasting, and predictive modeling using state-of-the-art techniques. The ideal candidate is passionate about turning data into actionable insights and has strong experience in model deployment within cloud environments (Azure, Databricks). You will collaborate closely with data engineers, ML engineers, and business stakeholders to deliver end-to-end data science solutions that optimize commercial performance.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and optimize recommendation systems (collaborative filtering, content-based, hybrid approaches)
  • Build and validate time series forecasting models using ARIMA, Prophet, LSTM, and other ML-based methods
  • Implement and tune boosting algorithms (XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost) and decision tree-based models for classification and regression tasks
  • Perform end-to-end data exploration, feature engineering, and model evaluation
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to deploy models into production on Azure and Databricks
  • Translate business problems into analytical frameworks and communicate results to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Stay current with emerging trends and tools in machine learning and data science



Profile Requirements:

Education:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics , or a related quantitative field


Experience & Skills:

  • Proven experience in recommender systems and time series forecasting
  • Strong expertise in boosting algorithms (XGBoost, etc.) and decision trees
  • Proficiency in Python and key libraries: scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, statsmodels
  • Experience with Azure Machine Learning , Databricks , and cloud-based model deployment
  • Familiarity with C++ (a plus for performance-critical components)
  • Solid understanding of ML lifecycle , from prototyping to production
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken) – essential for global collaboration


Why Join Us?

  • Be part of a high-performing analytics team driving real business impact
  • Work on cutting-edge machine learning applications in a dynamic commercial environment
  • Access to modern tools and cloud infrastructure (Azure, Databricks)
  • Opportunities for growth within the Mantu Group ecosystem

title: the Local Sales Manager
description:
Job Profile for the Local Sales Manager in Brazil

2.Major: International trade, foreign languages, mechanical engineering, etc. Candidates with sales experience or background related to motorcycle industry are preferred.

(Two)Work Experience

1、At least 3 years of experience in the sales industry.

2、Candidates with experience in product sales in industries such as chain drive, automotive parts, home appliances, and motorcycles will be given priority consideration.

1、It is required to be proficient in both Portuguese and English or Portuguese and Chinese, with fluent skills in listening, speaking, reading and writing.

2、Possess excellent personal qualities, business negotiation skills, stress-resistance ability, result-oriented mindset, and the ability to adapt to frequent business trips.

3、Possess the abilities of team management, organizational coordination, work guidance, analysis and judgment, as well as problem-solving.。

Work Location: Brazil

Salary: Negotiable at interview.

title: Executivo Comercial Hunter para Grandes Contas - Mercado Pago | Curitiba, PR
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!


Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.

Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico, para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.

title: Analista Contábil Regulatório Pleno
description:
Sobre nós


Somos a Forvis Mazars, com mais de 80 anos de expertise global e mais de 20 anos de presença no Brasil. Presente em mais de 100 países, nossos colaboradores estão a postos para apoiar sua empresa com serviços de Auditoria, Consultoria e BPO reconhecidos pelo mercado no Brasil e no mundo.


Como é atuar conosco


Por meio da nossa área de Alocação de Talentos, você poderá colocar sua experiência em prática em contextos empresariais variados, contribuindo com nosso padrão de excelência em distintas operações e segmentos.


Ao ser alocado em uma de nossas demandas externas, você terá a oportunidade de atuar em ambientes dinâmicos e desafiadores, colaborando diretamente para o sucesso de nossos clientes. Essa contribuição proporciona vivência prática e aprendizado constante. E você contará com o acompanhamento próximo da equipe Forvis Mazars, garantindo alinhamento ao longo de toda a sua atuação.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições


  • Atuar no suporte, revisão e aprimoramento dos processos de reportes regulatórios ao Banco Central (Cadocs), garantindo conformidade com a regulamentação vigente;

  • Apoiar no desenho, correção e padronização dos processos de geração de informações regulatórias;

  • Atuar em projetos de melhoria contínua dos processos de reporte regulatório e integração sistêmica;
  • Realizar análises de variações, reconciliações e validações cruzadas entre bases contábeis e regulatórias;
  • Apoiar no atendimento a auditorias internas, externas e fiscalizações relacionadas a reportes regulatórios;
  • Atuar de forma próxima às áreas de Contabilidade, TI e Compliance para resolução de inconsistências e ajustes de processos.


Requisitos e Qualificações


  • Formação superior completa em Contabilidade, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida em contabilidade regulatória e reportes ao Banco Central (Cadocs), com domínio do COSIF;
  • Vivência com integração e reconciliação entre sistemas contábeis e regulatórios (ex.: Oracle, Matera ou similares);
  • Forte conhecimento de normas e exigências regulatórias aplicáveis a instituições financeiras;
  • Perfil analítico, atento a detalhes e com forte senso de controle e conformidade;
  • Experiência em mapeamento contábil, validação de dados e construção de controles;
  • Excel intermediário/avançado para análises, conciliações e validações de bases de dados;
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação para interação com áreas técnicas, contábeis e de tecnologia;
  • Desejável experiência em projetos de melhoria de processos regulatórios ou implantação de sistemas.


O que esperamos de você


  • Comprometimento com prazos, entregas e qualidade do trabalho;
  • Capacidade de adaptação a diferentes ambientes e rotinas corporativas;
  • Proatividade na resolução de problemas e execução das atividades;

title: Collections Specialist
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay . CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.


Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.


About the job

As a Collections Specialist, your mission is to execute recoveries hands-on while building the foundations of a scalable, fair, and data-driven collections function.

You will work directly on active cases — negotiating, prioritizing, escalating, and resolving — while also turning what you learn into clear playbooks, policies, and operating processes.

This role sits at the intersection of execution and design:

  • You recover capital today
  • You help ensure we recover it better, faster, and more predictably tomorrow


Qualifications

  • Strong experience in collections in Brazil .
  • Fluent in Portuguese and basic English.
  • Solid understanding of legal and judicial recovery frameworks .
  • Comfortable working with data, dashboards, and cohorts .
  • Ability to reason about effort vs. yield economics .
  • Working knowledge of SQL / BI tools (hands-on or close collaboration).
  • Highly execution-oriented — comfortable being in the weeds.
  • Structured thinker who turns chaos into process.
  • Clear, practical communicator with Ops, Risk, and Legal.
  • Ownership mindset — sees gaps and fills them.


Responsibilities

  • Execute collections hands-on across delinquency stages and products.
  • Manage negotiations and recoveries , including complex or sensitive cases.
  • Help design and maintain collections playbooks and policies .
  • Continuously improve case prioritization and escalation logic .
  • Partner with Data to translate execution insights into better segmentation and models.
  • Support and monitor external partners (law firms, agencies).
  • Track and communicate recovery performance and operational insights.
  • Act as a builder of the collections function , not just an operator.


What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.


But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
  • Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.
  • Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
  • Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
  • off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

title: Mid/Senior Android Developer
description:

Working with us implies:

  • Opportunities to build valuable skills, work with unique and interesting projects for the sports industry, express and implement your ideas and grow your career.

﻿

title: National Sales Director (Brazil)
description:
Job Title: National Sales Director - Brazil

Reports To: Head of Overseas Business Unit

Location: Brazil (Remote, frequent travel required)


Position Overview

To support the company's strategic development, we are investing significantly in the Brazilian market to accelerate brand growth, product localization, and sales network expansion. We are seeking a National Sales Director for Brazil who will be responsible for the overall market strategy, sales planning, channel development, and team leadership. The goal is to rapidly achieve broad product coverage across Brazil and develop tailored product and sales strategies for the local market.

The ideal candidate will have established nationwide distributor and customer relationships, enabling them to contribute immediately. Preference will be given to candidates with prior experience at leading baking ingredient manufacturers in a similar role.


Key Responsibilities

A. Market Strategy & Planning

  1. Develop and execute the overall sales strategy, channel plan, and annual business objectives for Brazil.
  2. Lead product localization initiatives to meet Brazilian market needs and drive product adaptation.
  3. Rapidly expand the national sales network to ensure broad market coverage.

B. Channel Development & Management

  1. Identify, negotiate with, and onboard national distributors and key strategic partners.
  2. Manage relationships with distributors and major customers, optimizing processes and service delivery.
  3. Maintain distributor and customer profiles, conduct regular performance reviews, and implement improvement plans.

C. Brand & Marketing Promotion

  1. Develop and implement brand-building activities, including marketing campaigns, PR events, and digital outreach.
  2. Organize product demonstrations, technical trainings, and industry exhibitions to increase brand visibility.

D. Cross-functional Collaboration

  1. Work closely with product, R&D, and marketing teams to share market insights and support product development.
  2. Provide training and support to distributors and customers on products, applications, and sales techniques.

E. Market & Competitive Intelligence

  1. Monitor competitor activities, market trends, and regulatory changes to adjust strategies proactively.
  2. Prepare regular market reports and business forecasts for headquarters.


Qualifications

A. Experience

  1. Minimum 15 years of sales management experience in the baking ingredients industry, with a focus on non-dairy whipping toppings or related products, specifically in the Brazilian market.
  2. Previous experience in a similar role at companies is highly preferred.
  3. Established network of national distributors and key clients, with the ability to execute quickly.

B. Knowledge

  1. Full understanding of bakery products and familiarity with bakery operations or production processes.
  2. Proficient in Microsoft Office for data analysis, reporting, and presentation.

C. Competency

  1. Strong strategic thinking, negotiation skills, and business acumen.
  2. Resilient under pressure and willing to travel frequently.
  3. Excellent collaboration and stakeholder management skills.


We Offer

  1. Competitive compensation package.
  2. Opportunity to lead in a high-priority strategic market with significant growth potential.
  3. Full support from global headquarters in product, marketing, and technical resources.



About Hi-Road Food Technology

Shanghai Hi-road Food Technology Co., Ltd. is a leading integrated enterprise specializing in the research, development, production, and distribution of premium bakery and catering ingredients. Committed to becoming the preferred partner in the global baking industry, we dedicate ourselves to providing customers with innovative, safe, and delicious food solutions.

With our strong independent R&D capabilities, Hi-Road meticulously sources world-class raw materials and employs advanced production technologies. Our comprehensive quality control system ensures the consistent excellence of our diverse product portfolio, which includes:

•Dairy and non-dairy toppings

•Premium fruit preparations

•Chocolate products

•Bakery creams and margarine compounds

•Flavor sauces

•Food flavors and additives

Through continuous innovation and stringent quality standards, we strive to deliver exceptional value and culinary inspiration to our partners worldwide
company: 上海海融食品科技股份有限公司 Hi-Road Food Technology

title: Sales Specialist
description:

BGI Genomics was founded in 1999 with the vision of using genomics to benefit mankind and has since become the largest genomic life science organization in the world. With a focus on research and applications in the healthcare, agriculture, conservation, and environmental fields, BGI has a proven track record of innovative, high-profile research, which has generated over 2,000 publications, many in top-tier journals such as Nature and Science. BGI now operating and serving customers in more than 100 countries and areas and with around 10,000 employees all over the world.


Our mission is to transform people’s lives for the better. We don’t hesitate to take bold decisions that can help us to achieve new breakthroughs. We believe that the success of our business will mean a better world for people to live in.


Our message to the world is simple – make everyone’s life healthier and longer with help of BGI.


Why joining us?


Here at BGI we bring the most talented and dedicated to science and business professionals to act as one to deliver the outstanding technology and services to people.


Our multicultural team is engaged in a challenging work that brings satisfaction and unlimited professional growth. We keep learning and upgrading ourselves, we support each other in order to achieve the best result.


Why do we want you?


We invite to partner only the best experts who will work side by side promoting BGI’s values, products and services. And that’s why, we are confident that your business expertise and deep knowledge of genomics will help us deliver our message to the world and build strong relationship with a community.



Job Purpose & Principal Accountabilities:


1. Responsible for formulating and implementing an effective sales plan, achieving the regional sales goals within the forecasted budget, and developing a key account sales strategy.

2. Understand and master the company's current portfolio of products and services. Stay abreast of technology developments, market competition, laws, and regulations relevant to the business. Use resources and research to identify the sales plan and strategy for different market segments.

3. Carry on regional business analysis and report to regional managers regularly. Evaluate the budget performance, product performance, and operational efficiency, and report recommendations and results to the team's leader.

4. Screen for relevant business opportunities in R&D, clinical and pharmaceutical fields. Develop and maintain relationships with key opinion leaders; use clients' resources and feedback to expand the influence of BGI and safeguard key market opportunities.

5. Work in coordination with project managers, production teams, and others to guarantee the smooth implementation of the project and timely and correctly communicate the project status to the clients. Work with product managers to promote product development through collaboration with key customers.

6. Participate in national and regional conferences, trade fairs, and company meetings.

7. Understand BGI's values and expand BGI's vision in overseas markets.


Job Knowledge, Skills, and Experience:


1. In-depth knowledge of NGS and IVD markets and customer needs in this industry.

2. In-depth knowledge of selling next-generation sequencing and other genomic services such as microarray, genotyping, in vitro diagnosis, etc.

3. Experience with government relations and lobbying for the pharmaceutical and biotech industry.

4. Excellent communication, analytical and organizational skills.

5. Willingness to travel.

6. Fluency in English, (Chinese preferred )

7.Base Sao Paulo.


Competences:


a. At least two years of experience in customer management in the biotechnology or Healthcare industry.

b. A Bachelor's Degree or above in biology, biochemistry, molecular biology, bioinformatics or equivalent.

title: Facility Manager
description:
Americas Cluster Operations Team


We are the Americas Cluster Operations Team, a critical component of a leading global technology enterprise's infrastructure strategy. Our mission is to ensure the highly efficient, stable, and secure operation of the operational environment across the Americas. We are dedicated to delivering "last mile customer value" from our operational facilities, providing a seamless, reliable, and highly efficient service experience.


Our team comprises dedicated professionals in Facilities, IT, and Asset Management, deeply experienced in large-scale system operations, possessing comprehensive capabilities from daily operations to strategic planning:

Facilities Team: Responsible for 24x7 uninterrupted operations and emergency response of critical physical support systems within the large operational environment, including electrical, HVAC, and fire suppression. We ensure physical environment stability and sustainable operations through rigorous capacity management and energy efficiency optimization.

IT Team: Manages the full lifecycle operations of IT equipment like servers and networks within the operational environment. We ensure high SLA compliance for IT services through proactive systemic risk governance, automation, and process optimization, while leading various technology upgrade projects.

Asset Team: Oversees the full lifecycle management and governance of IT assets. We ensure asset compliance, visibility, and efficient utilization through precise data management, risk control, and cost-efficiency strategies.


Our Core Focuses:

End-to-End Reliability: From physical support to IT services, we provide comprehensive stability assurance, focused on mitigating risks and ensuring business continuity.

Project-Based & Lean Operations: We approach operational work through a project lens, continuously optimizing processes to achieve efficient resource utilization and lean operating costs.

Innovation & Talent Development: We actively integrate cutting-edge technologies and foster robust knowledge-sharing mechanisms to continuously enhance our team's professional capabilities and innovative practices.

We serve as the robust foundation for the enterprise's business growth in the Americas, providing powerful and trustworthy infrastructure assurance through professionalism, innovation, and collaboration.


Job Responsibilities:

1. Responsible for the daily operation and maintenance management of large-scale operational facilities within the responsible region, ensuring the efficient, stable, and compliant operation of their critical physical support systems (e.g., power, HVAC, fire suppression).

2. Develop and implement facility operation strategies, procedures, and emergency plans, ensuring facility operations comply with internal standards and external regulations.

3. Manage the facility operations team, including recruitment, training, performance evaluation, and daily supervision, to enhance team professionalism and cohesion.

4. Lead facility capacity planning, energy efficiency management, and optimization projects, promoting sustainable operation practices and reducing operational costs.

5. Manage facility-related vendors and service providers, ensuring service quality and SLA compliance.

6. Lead or participate in root cause analysis for facility incidents, and the development and implementation of corrective actions.

7. Collaborate closely with internal cross-functional teams (e.g., IT, Security, Business Units) to ensure facility operations effectively support overall business objectives.


Job Requirements:

1. Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, HVAC, Automation, or a related engineering discipline.

description:

title: Chief Legal Officer
description:
Gold & Aron Conseil is an executive search company. We are recruiting a CLO on behalf of our client.


Our client is a growing Brazilian fintech with strong social impact and evolving from a startup into a disciplined, institutional-grade organization. In order to accelerate growth even more, the firm is seeking a Chief Legal Officer . The Ideal candidate is someone who can lead all legal related initiatives, navigate complex landscapes, build & manage a high performing team, serve as a trusted advisor to the founders and get things done (not as an advisor but as a legal executive-operator).


Responsibilities

  • Manage all legal matters (mostly domestic but some international exposure as well).
  • Build, structure, and lead a high-performing in-house legal team, including: (i) Defining clear scopes between in-house vs. external counsel; (ii) Hiring, developing, and, when necessary, upgrading talent; (iii) Implementing SLAs, prioritization frameworks, and legal intake processes; (iv) Ensuring legal is a force multiplier, not a bottleneck
  • Process Professionalization: Transition the legal department from "startup mode" to a disciplined "financial institution standard".
  • Risk Optimization: Translate legal constraints into business options. Quantify downside, propose alternatives, and recommend paths that maximize long-term enterprise value
  • Regulatory: Manage the process of applying for SCD (Sociedade de Crédito Direto) License, exposure to Central Bank of Brazil (BCB), Open Finance, Consumer protection at scale (BACEN + SENACON dynamics), Structuring new financial products under regulatory ambiguity
  • Be ready to contribute to potential capital raise/M&A processes, manage data rooms, oversee due diligence, and negotiate complex term sheets.


Qualifications

  • 15–20 years of experience.
  • Ideal candidate will bring a generalist expertise being able to navigate Brazilian Employment law, Tax basics, Contract law (Brazil & International), Regulatory, M&A.
  • Ideal candidate has a combination of top-tier law firm and in-house
  • Start-up experience (ideally at a Fintech)
  • Proven People Leadership
  • Language: English fluency is a must.
  • Location: São Paulo. (Hybrid work environment)


This role is NOT for:

  • Pure advisory profiles who prefer external counsel to execution
  • Lawyers who have not personally built, hired, and performance-managed teams
  • Professionals uncomfortable making fast risk trade-offs with imperfect information
  • Candidates who need heavy structure before acting

title: Product Owner
description:
ENGLISH RESUMES ONLY


JOB DESCRIPTION

The Product Owner (PO) for the Revenue Management System (RMS) is responsible for shaping and delivering integrated solutions that support pricing, demand forecasting, and revenue optimization. This role involves managing initiatives that span data engineering, machine learning, and user-facing interfaces. In addition to gathering and managing business requirements, the PO will be responsible for overseeing the full delivery lifecycle to ensure successful execution from concept through release.


DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Develop and maintain a backlog of features and enhancements spanning data pipelines, predictive models, and RMS user interfaces.

Identify and prioritize high-value opportunities to optimize pricing strategies and demand forecasting.

Gather, analyze, and document business requirements and translate them into detailed epics and user stories with clear descriptions, business rules, and acceptance criteria.

Own the full delivery lifecycle of features and enhancements, ensuring timely execution, alignment with stakeholders, and readiness for deployment.

Collaborate with Data Engineering on requirements for data sourcing, integration, and quality.

Partner with Data Science to define, deploy, and iterate on ML models and pricing algorithms.

Align with UI/UX and front-end teams to ensure a seamless user experience.

Facilitate cross-functional workshops and planning sessions with business stakeholders.

Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess product success and user adoption.

Ensure accurate documentation in Confluence and Jira for themes, epics, and tasks.

Coordinate with QA to validate features and ensure delivery meets requirements.

Promote continuous iteration based on stakeholder feedback and performance data.

Drive change management and support user training for new RMS features.

Ensure compliance with data governance, security, and regulatory standards.

Identify and mitigate risks associated with process and system changes.

Actively participate in Agile ceremonies including backlog grooming, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.

Perform other job-related functions as assigned.


QUALIFICATIONS

DEGREE TYPE:

Bachelor's Degree


FIELD(S) OF STUDY:

Business Management, Data Analytics, or related fields


EXPERIENCE;

  • At least 3 years of experience in end-to-end product ownership, product management, or delivery of data or optimization platforms.
  • Experience working across Data Engineering, Data Science, and UI Development teams, as well with multiple stakeholders and brand Revenue Management teams.
  • Experience working in Agile software development environments with cross-functional teams.
  • Industry experience in cruise, travel, or enterprise data systems is a plus.


COMPETENCIES/SKILLS

  • Exposure to revenue management, pricing systems, or forecasting tools is preferred
  • Strong understanding of Agile delivery methodologies and iterative development
  • Familiarity with data pipelines, ML model lifecycle, and modern UI patterns
  • Ability to define and refine user stories across technical and business domains
  • Proficient in Jira, Confluence, and backlog management tools
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Excellent facilitation, documentation, and analytical skills
  • Understanding of change management principles and user adoption strategies
  • High attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities
  • Strong business acumen and problem-solving capabilities
  • Adaptability in fast-paced, cross-functional environments


CERTIFICATIONS/LICENSES

Add certifications/licenses (if any) here.

  • Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or similar Agile certification preferred
  • Product Management or Lean Six Sigma certification is a plus


ENGLISH RESUMES ONLY

title: IT Operations Manager
description:
We are the Americas Cluster Operations Team, a critical component of a leading global technology enterprise's infrastructure strategy. Our mission is to ensure the highly efficient, stable, and secure operation of the operational environment across the Americas. Our team comprises dedicated professionals in Facilities, IT, and Asset Management, deeply experienced in large-scale system operations, possessing comprehensive capabilities from daily operations to strategic planning:Facilities Team: Responsible for 24x7 uninterrupted operations and emergency response of critical physical support systems within the large operational environment, including electrical, HVAC, and fire suppression. We ensure physical environment stability and sustainable operations through rigorous capacity management and energy efficiency optimization.IT Team: Manages the full lifecycle operations of IT equipment like servers and networks within the operational environment. We ensure high SLA compliance for IT services through proactive systemic risk governance, automation, and process optimization, while leading various technology upgrade projects.Asset Team: Oversees the full lifecycle management and governance of IT assets. We ensure asset compliance, visibility, and efficient utilization through precise data management, risk control, and cost-efficiency strategies.Our Core Focuses:End-to-End Reliability: From physical support to IT services, we provide comprehensive stability assurance, focused on mitigating risks and ensuring business continuity.Project-Based & Lean Operations: We approach operational work through a project lens, continuously optimizing processes to achieve efficient resource utilization and lean operating costs.Innovation & Talent Development: We actively integrate cutting-edge technologies and foster robust knowledge-sharing mechanisms to continuously enhance our team's professional capabilities and innovative practices.We serve as the robust foundation for the enterprise's business growth in the Americas, providing powerful and trustworthy infrastructure assurance through professionalism, innovation, and collaboration.


Job Responsibilities:

1. Responsible for the comprehensive operation and maintenance management of IT infrastructure (including but not limited to servers, networks, storage, and related software platforms) within large-scale operational environments in the Americas region.

2. Develop and implement IT operation strategies, procedures, and standards (SOPs) to ensure the efficient, stable, and secure operation of IT systems, in compliance with internal and external regulations.

3. Manage the IT operations team, including recruitment, training, performance evaluation, team development, and daily management, to enhance team professionalism and efficiency.

4. Lead IT incident management, event response, change management, and problem-solving processes to ensure high availability and business continuity of IT systems.

5. Drive the IT operations' transformation towards automation and intelligence, introducing advanced technologies and tools to continuously optimize operational processes, efficiency, and quality.

6. Responsible for IT infrastructure capacity planning, performance monitoring, and optimization to ensure resource allocation meets business growth demands.

7. Manage IT-related vendors and third-party service providers, ensuring their service quality and SLA (Service Level Agreement) compliance.

8. Responsible for IT operations budget planning, cost control, and analysis of technology investment returns.

9. Collaborate closely with internal cross-functional teams (e.g., Facilities, Asset Management, Security, Business Units) to ensure IT operations effectively support overall business objectives.

10. Stay abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies, supporting the evolution of IT architecture to enhance technological competitiveness.



Job Requirements:

1. Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Network Engineering, Electronic Information Engineering, or a related IT professional field.

2. Over 5 years of experience in large-scale IT system operation and maintenance management, with at least 3 years in a team management role; experience in multinational corporations is a plus.

3. In-depth understanding and practical experience with server hardware, operating systems (Linux/Windows), network technologies (TCP/IP, routing & switching), and storage systems.

4. Familiar with ITIL/ITSM management frameworks, possessing excellent capabilities in ITIL process implementation and optimization.

5. Practical experience with IT automation and intelligent operation tools (e.g., scripting languages, monitoring systems, configuration management tools).

6. Excellent team leadership, project management, and risk management capabilities.

7. Outstanding communication, coordination, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, capable of handling complex technical and managerial issues.

8. Strong English reading, writing, and communication skills, able to communicate effectively as a working language.

9. (Plus) Relevant professional certifications such as ITIL, PMP, CCIE/CCNP, RHCE are a plus.

10. (Plus) Experience in cloud platform operations or DevOps practices is a plus.

title: RippleX Partner Director
description:
At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs. 

If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.

THE WORK:

Are you a strategic leader with deep experience in relationship management and a passion for tokenization, institutional finance, and blockchain technology? As a Partner Director on the RippleX Partner Success team, you'll play a key role in accelerating the growth and impact of the XRPL ecosystem. You will serve as a trusted advisor to a portfolio of high-profile partners—including financial institutions, fintechs, and crypto-native builders—guiding them through every stage of their journey: from idea to integration to go-live and scale.

This is not a passive role. You will be hands-on in shaping tokenization strategies, architecting utility on-chain, and removing roadblocks in dynamic, high-stakes environments. Your day-to-day will span deep technical discussions and executive-level strategic planning—always with the goal of maximizing partner success and driving meaningful, on-ledger activity.

If you're excited to unlock real-world utility through tokenized assets and thrive at the intersection of institutional finance and blockchain innovation, we’d love to hear from you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Own and lead a portfolio of highly strategic and complex Institutional DeFi partners building on XRPL, with a focus on scaled adoption of tokenized asset use cases.
  • Define and drive strategic account plans that maximize long-term value for both Ripple and its partners.
  • Lead execution across technical and GTM workstreams, anticipating risks and aligning cross-functional resources to ensure successful outcomes.
  • Provide thought leadership and guidance to partners around tokenization, utility, regulatory considerations, and financial market structures.
  • Build and maintain strong executive relationships with C-level stakeholders at partner organizations, and act as a senior voice across Ripple internal teams.
  • Represent partner needs and priorities internally, influencing RippleX’s roadmap, product strategy, and go-to-market motions.
  • Identify opportunities for broader ecosystem impact and partner cross-collaboration to accelerate XRPL utility.
  • Travel to partner and customer sites as needed (20–30%).

WHAT YOU'LL BRING: 

  • 10–12+ years of experience leading strategic partnerships or enterprise engagements in fintech, financial services, or blockchain—ideally with a focus on innovation and emerging tech.
  • Institutional Finance Acumen: Deep understanding of financial instruments and market structure (equities, bonds, repos, collateralized lending, etc.). Strong grasp of collateral management, capital efficiency, and how DeFi can impact these processes. Familiarity with regulatory frameworks (Basel III, MiFID, EMIR, etc.) and how they relate to tokenisation and digital asset adoption
  • Tokenization Expertise: Strong command of tokenization models, use cases, and best practices. Able to influence strategy and guide partner implementation across the asset lifecycle.
  • Blockchain Fluency: Deep understanding of blockchain fundamentals and how they can be applied to financial use cases such as tokenization, settlement, and collateral management. Ability to evaluate different protocol features (e.g., scalability, finality, cost, security) and articulate how they impact institutional DeFi applications. Experience advising on interoperability protocols and bridging technologies (e.g., Axelar) to support cross-chain integration and ecosystem connectivity.
  • Go-to-Market & Utility Creation: Proven track record of launching scalable GTM strategies that result in sustained on-chain activity and partner adoption. Ability to cross-pollinate within Ripple and across partners.
  • Partner Enablement & Growth: Extensive experience leading strategic partnerships and enterprise relationships, with a focus on enabling partners from ideation through to build, compliance readiness, and scaled deployment. Adept at managing complex stakeholder dynamics across technical, product, and executive functions. Proven ability to proactively remove obstacles and shape partner strategy to drive momentum, unlock long-term value, and deliver measurable impact on ecosystem growth.
  • Problem Solving with Agency: Bias for action and proactive problem solving, especially when navigating ambiguity or institutional inertia. Strong “ownership mindset” to help partners go from idea to deployment with confidence. Strategic thinker with a proactive mindset—skilled at managing through ambiguity, resolving friction, and anticipating downstream impact.
  • Executive Presence & Trust Building: Experienced engaging at the C-suite level at tier 1 banks and asset managers, with credibility, empathy, and strategic insight. Trusted advisor in high-stakes conversations. Skilled in managing sensitive conversations (regulatory risk, commercial conflicts, etc.).
  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Comfortable driving alignment and influencing roadmaps across multiple internal teams to ensure success at scale.

WHO WE ARE:

Do Your Best Work

  • The opportunity to build in a fast-paced start-up environment with experienced industry leaders
  • A learning environment where you can dive deep into the latest technologies and make an impact.  A professional development budget to support other modes of learning.
  • Thrive in an environment where no matter what race, ethnicity, gender, origin, or culture they identify with, every employee is a respected, valued, and empowered part of the team.
  • In-office collaboration for moments that matter is important to our culture, and we give managers and teams the flexibility to decide which 10+ days a month they come in. 
  • Bi-weekly all-company meeting - business updates and ask me anything style discussion with our Leadership Team
  • We come together for moments that matter which include team offsites, team bonding activities, happy hours and more!

Take Control of Your Finances

  • Competitive salary, bonuses, and equity
  • Competitive benefits that cover physical and mental healthcare, retirement, family forming, and family support
  • Employee giving match
  • Mobile phone stipend

Take Care of Yourself

  • R&R days so you can rest and recharge
  • Generous wellness reimbursement and weekly onsite & virtual programming
  • Generous vacation policy - work with your manager to take time off when you need it
  • Industry-leading parental leave policies. Family planning benefits.
  • Catered lunches, fully-stocked kitchens with premium snacks/beverages, and plenty of fun events

Benefits listed above are for full-time employees. 

Ripple is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We do not discriminate against qualified employees or applicants because of race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, sexual identity, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, military status, or any other characteristic protected by local law or ordinance.  Please find our UK/EU Applicant Privacy Notice and our California Applicant Privacy Notice for reference.

title: General Manager of South America Region
description:
Reports To: President, Overseas Business Group

Location:São Paulo, Brazil (or key city in primary operating country).

Extensive travel within South America is required.

Employment Type: Full-time


About Star Charge:

Star Charge is a global leader in electric vehicle charging equipment manufacturing and charging network operation. We are committed to building a worldwide new energy mobility service network through innovative technology and services. We are actively expanding into the South American market and seeking a visionary and experienced leader

to drive the full-scale development of our business in the region from zero to one and beyond.


Position Summary:

As the General Manager for the South America Region, you will be fully responsible for developing and executing the overall strategy for Star Charge in South America, achieving rapid growth in market share, revenue, and profitability. You will be the business founder and core leader, establishing local operations, managing government relations, strategic partnerships, market expansion, sales delivery, and service operations.


Key Responsibilities:

1. Strategy & Planning:

Develop long-term market development strategy, annual business plans, and financial budgets for the South America region. Conduct in-depth analysis of policy environments, competitive landscapes, customer needs, and industry trends in key South American

countries (e.g., Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Argentina). Identify market opportunities and potential risks, formulating corresponding market entry and competitive strategies.

2. Business Development & Sales:

Lead and personally engage in acquiring, negotiating with, and maintaining relationships with key clients (e.g., OEMs, energy companies, large commercial real estate, retail chains, government projects). Establish and manage a diversified sales channel network, including direct sales, distributors, and strategic partners. Lead major project bidding to ensure regional sales and market share targets are achieved.

3. Operations & Localization Management:

Oversee the daily operations of the South American subsidiary. Establish and optimize the local team structure, business processes, financial and compliance systems. Supervise the construction, operation, and maintenance quality of the charging network, ensuring excellent user experience and service reliability.

4. Government Relations & Public Affairs:

Represent the company to build and maintain strong relationships with government bodies, industry associations, and media across South American countries. Closely monitor and proactively influence policies and standards related to EVs and charging infrastructure.

5. Team Building & Leadership:

Recruit, develop, motivate, and manage a high-performing local team, fostering a positive and efficient organizational culture. Act as the bridge between the regional team and global headquarters, ensuring strategic alignment and resource synergy.


Qualifications & Requirements:

1. Education & Experience:

Bachelor's degree or above; MBA, Engineering, Economics, or related field preferred. Minimum 10 years of professional experience, with at least 5 years in a general management or senior business development role in South America. Experience in new energy, automotive, energy infrastructure, industrial products, or technology sectors is highly preferred. Proven track record of successfully building a new market or business line from scratch.

2. Competencies & Skills:

Exceptional Business Acumen & Strategic Thinking: Ability to develop clear business strategies and execute effectively.

Outstanding Sales & Negotiation Skills: Proven history of closing large contracts or strategic partnerships.

Strong Leadership & Team Management:Ability to lead diverse, cross-cultural teams.

Excellent Communication & Interpersonal Skills: Proficiency in engaging with government officials, C-level executives, and internal/external stakeholders.

Solid Financial & Analytical Skills: P&L ownership and data-driven decision-making capability.

Strong Problem-Solving & Resilience: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic market environment.

3. Language Requirements:

Fluency in English and Spanish is mandatory.

4. Others:

Passion for the new energy industry and alignment with the

company's vision.

Willingness to be based in South America long-term and travel

extensively.

description:

E embora sejamos uma organização verdadeiramente global, permanecemos profundamente enraizados nas comunidades em que operamos e em que nosso pessoal vive e trabalha.

Valorizamos ser inclusivos. Abraçamos e celebramos a diversidade de cada um de nossos funcionários. E com cada novo membro de nossa equipe, ficamos ainda mais fortes. Nossas estrelas estão se alinhando. Então junte-se a nossa equipe e aspire pela grandeza.


CONTRATO TEMPORÁRIO - 2 ANOS


PRINCIPAIS DESAFIOS:


- Impulsionar o comprometimento do fornecedor e desafiar os planos de ação de qualidade para problemas relacionados à manufatura do fornecedor;


- Envolver o fornecedor no nível adequado da organização para garantir reatividade na implementação de soluções de manufatura;


- Assegurar que os obstáculos (ex.: convergência de qualidade, prazos, capacidade) sejam escalados ao nível apropriado da organização do fornecedor e que planos de ação recorrentes sejam definidos e acompanhados;


- Lançar ações de contenção, em colaboração com a Engenharia, a fim de garantir a entrega de peças sem comprometer o plano de desenvolvimento do veículo (quality wall, plano de controle reforçado, retrabalho de peças);


- Estabelecer acompanhamento periódico com o fornecedor e com o SQE para garantir que os planos de ação sejam executados dentro do prazo;


- Assegurar uma comunicação eficiente com as equipes de projeto, engenharia, qualidade, planta e compras;


- Participar ativamente dos eventos de qualidade do projeto e das atividades de reporte de qualidade do veículo;


- Garantir reporte regular sobre problemas de manufatura dos fornecedores para as equipes de projeto e compras;


- Organizar reuniões de Supplier Quality Room com a equipe do projeto, envolvendo os fornecedores mais críticos.


REQUISITOS NECESSÁRIOS:


Superior Completo em Engenharia (Industrial, Mecânica, Produção, Automotiva, Materiais ou áreas afins);


- Especialização em áreas de gestão de projetos, qualidade e áreas correlacionadas;


- Formação técnica / especializada: APQP / PPAP (AIAG / VDA). IATF 16949 e fundamentos da ISO 9001;


- Conhecimento em Ferramentas da Qualidade (Core Tools): FMEA (DFMEA / PFMEA), Plano de Controle, MSA, SP, Metodologias de resolução de problemas: 8D, 5 Porquês, Ishikawa, auditorias de processo e produto (VDA 6.3 como diferencial) e avaliação de capacidade e risco ( , Capacity Evaluation);


- Conhecimento de processos de fabricação e montagem;


- Experiencia em auditorias e sistema de gestão da qualidade, Supplier Quality / Engenharia da Qualidade / Qualidade Industrial, Gestão de fornecedores no setor automotivo e Lançamento de projetos e industrialização;


- Inglês intermediário.

title: Estagiário (Processos)
description:
Sobre a Lockton

Fundada há mais de 50 anos por Jack Lockton em Kansas City, a Lockton desenvolveu uma marca internacionalmente reconhecida pela qualidade e eficiência nos serviços que oferecemos. Graças a lealdade de nossos clientes, que nos permitiu crescer expressivamente nos últimos anos, a Lockton hoje está entre as maiores corretoras de seguro do mundo, conquistando a taxa de crescimento orgânico mais rápida do mercado de corretoras


Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

  • Apoiar no mapeamento, desenho e revisão de processos internos, utilizando ferramentas de modelagem quando necessário.
  • Auxiliar na padronização de fluxos, documentos e controles da área.
  • Apoiar na implantação de melhorias identificadas nos processos.
  • Coletar dados, organizar informações e contribuir com análises de eficiência operacional.
  • Acompanhar rotinas administrativas da área (agendas, organização de arquivos, registros e controles).
  • Conduzir pesquisas sobre benchmarks, boas práticas e tendências relacionadas a processos e projetos.
  • Auxiliar na elaboração de relatórios, apresentações e indicadores.
  • Acompanhar projetos internos, apoiando no monitoramento de prazos, riscos, entregáveis e comunicação.
  • Dar suporte no uso de ferramentas de gestão de projetos e processos (ex.: Trello, Excel, sistemas internos).
  • Colaborar com áreas parceiras para garantir fluidez e clareza nos fluxos operacionais.



Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Conhecimentos básicos em metodologias ágeis, como Scrum e Kanban, ou princípios de Design Thinking.
  • Noções de ferramentas de pesquisa de mercado e análise de dados, incluindo Excel/Google Sheets.
  • Habilidade para criação e organização de materiais em PowerPoint/Google Slides.
  • Cursando Administração, Gestão de Projetos, Engenharia de produção, Gestão Empresarial, Processos Gerenciais.
  • Desejável inglês intermediário/ avançado.

description:

Somos a OPEN Solutions , uma empresa inovadora especializada no desenvolvimento de soluções para a indústria, integradas ao SAP ERP . Atuamos com tecnologia em nuvem e integração de sensores no chão de fábrica, levando eficiência, controle e inteligência operacional aos nossos clientes.


Com um time de 31 pessoas e sede em São José dos Campos/SP , transformamos ideias em software que gera impacto real na gestão industrial.


Nosso principal produto, OPEN Manufacturing / OPEN MES , integra PCP e chão de fábrica aos sistemas ERP e APS, apoiando empresas na jornada da Indústria 4.0 .


Nossa visão é ambiciosa: levar nossas soluções ao mercado global e alcançar 17 mil usuários até 2027 .

·       Noções de controle de versão com Git.

·       Familiaridade com ferramentas de CI/CD e testes automatizados.

·       Familiaridade com arquiteturas de microsserviços.

·       Conceitos de segurança em desenvolvimento back-end.

title: FICC L2 Application Support Engineer (Front Office)
description:
ITC Infotech is looking for FICC L2 Application Support Engineer (Front Office) to join our team in Sao Paulo, Brazil.

Experience: 03-07 Years.

Working Mode: 5 days Onsite.

Language Required: English (Fluent)


About Us:

ITC Infotech is a leading global technology services and solutions provider, led by Business and Technology Consulting. ITC Infotech provides business-friendly solutions to help clients succeed and be future-ready, by seamlessly bringing together digital expertise, strong industry speciﬁc alliances and the unique ability to leverage deep domain expertise from ITC Group businesses. We provide technology solutions and services to enterprises across industries such as Banking & Financial Services, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Consumer Goods, Travel and Hospitality, through a combination of traditional and newer business models, as a long-term sustainable partner.


Job Summary:

We are hiring a proactive and technically strong L2 Application Support Engineer to support FICC front-office applications in a fast-paced production environment.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Analyze, debug, and resolve production issues efficiently within SLA
  • Perform deep root cause analysis (RCA) and implement permanent fixes
  • Raise and manage incidents, assess business impact, and communicate updates to stakeholders
  • Create and track problem tickets, working closely with Development teams to drive permanent resolution
  • Escalate complex issues to L3 and management when required
  • Debug and fix defects in the existing codebase
  • Optimize system performance, scalability, and reliability
  • Collaborate closely with Development, QA, and Infrastructure teams


Mandatory Requirements:

  • Good Knowledge on object oriented programming experience (Java, C++, Python, etc)
  • Experience in L2 Application Support
  • Development experience (preferred or combined with support)
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting mindset
  • Ability to manage incidents independently and stay proactive throughout the day
  • Good understanding of application flow, logs, databases, and system integrations
  • Ability to work in a high-pressure front-office environment


Good to have:

  • Unix/ Linux
  • SQL/database understanding.

title: Analista de controle de qualidade
description:
